[
  {"step":1,"file":"src/md4c.c","function":"md_process_line","line":6528,"var":"ctx->parser.flags & MD_FLAG_ADMONITIONS","code":"if((ctx->parser.flags & MD_FLAG_ADMONITIONS) && ctx->n_containers > 0 && ctx->containers[ctx->n_containers-1].ch == '>' && ctx->current_block == NULL && ctx->n_block_bytes >= sizeof(MD_BLOCK))","note":"The quote-block admonition fast path is only taken when admonitions are enabled and the parser is currently inside a block quote."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src/md4c.c","function":"md_process_line","line":6532,"var":"block->type","code":"if(block->type == MD_BLOCK_QUOTE && line->end - line->beg > 3 && line->end - line->beg < 16 && CH(line->beg) == '[' && CH(line->beg+1) == '!' && CH(line->end-1) == ']')","note":"A line such as [!NOTE] is recognized as an admonition marker and the existing quote block is retagged in place."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src/md4c.c","function":"md_process_line","line":6541,"var":"ctx->containers[ctx->n_containers-1].is_admonition","code":"ctx->containers[ctx->n_containers-1].is_admonition = TRUE; block->type = MD_BLOCK_ADMONITION; block->data = i;","note":"The quote container becomes an admonition container, but this path does not clear any stale table-row continuation state."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/md4c.c","function":"md_process_line","line":6296,"var":"pivot_line->type","code":"if(pivot_line->type == MD_LINE_TABLE && n_parents == ctx->n_containers) { line->type = MD_LINE_TABLE; break; }","note":"Because the previous line was a table row, the next line inherits the table line type when the container depth still matches."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/md4c.c","function":"md_process_line","line":6489,"var":"line->type","code":"MD_CHECK(md_start_new_block(ctx, line));","note":"The parser starts a new block for the inherited line type while the stale table state is still active."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/md4c.c","function":"md_start_new_block","line":5190,"var":"line->type","code":"switch(line->type)","note":"The block dispatcher assumes only the enumerated line kinds can reach it."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src/md4c.c","function":"md_start_new_block","line":5225,"var":"line->type","code":"case MD_LINE_TABLEUNDERLINE: default: MD_UNREACHABLE();","note":"An unsupported line type reaches the default arm, which is the memory-safety sink described in the issue."}
]
EOF
